set.body:
Outcome: an actual LocalReference computation can authorize a MappingResult without executing reconstruction.
Scope: the D-approved portable producer, MappingResult and provenance/codec seam; no convenience CLI yet.
Acceptance: bind exact recall inventory, source snapshot/cut, canonical local evidence, profile and execution to the producer-owned record. Refuse foreign evidence/inventory/source and public forgery from outside the defining package. Preserve genuine registration-origin requirements for downstream measurement authority. On matched evidence the reference result's scientific rows equal the paired reference rows; declare full digest/receipt identity expectations under D rather than demanding identical execution identity. A lawful local-reference fixture with an invalid reconstruction grouping still produces and round-trips a reference record; independent trace/witness shows reconstruction was not invoked. Existing paired/weighted consumers keep their authority and refusal behavior. Do not introduce optional bogus reconstruction fields or unchecked caller-authored receipts.
Evidence: LocalReferenceBoundarySuite, MappingRunBoundarySuite, reference-isolation tests, ExpectedMappingContext/codec round trips and named guard mutations; all affected portable platforms and StoryAtlas seam.

Delivery rules: claim this bounded child with an explicit actor and mote begin before implementation; reserve only affected paths. One writer and at most one independent helper, one heavy gate at a time. No change to protected data admission, calibration authority or existing scientific acceptance. For code changes, compute scope with bash tools/reference-scope.sh BASE_SHA CANDIDATE_SHA in a verified standalone clone/export, use CI fatal warnings, all affected platforms and StoryAtlas checks for consumed surfaces. Record exact SHA, commands, exits and Passed/Failed/skipped totals; format last. Require independent exact-SHA review (SD2/SD6), external-package construction probes for new checked boundaries and named compiling mutation kills for new guards. Documentation-only work uses T2 review and format/integrity checks. Close only after the accepted slice lands within owner authorization; distinguish local, hosted and consumer evidence. Split further before editing if a child exceeds about one day. No publication/release or main movement is authorized by this planning request.
set.title: [mapping audit F] Add checked reference-only execution and record authority
